channel.title: Personal page of Somsubhra De
channel.description: I love working on problems with social impact. I find these areas interesting.. Generative and Responsible AI, Low-resource NLP, LLMs, evaluation, AI Safety, bias, Computational linguistics - If you're interested in collaborating with me, please connect, I would love to join subject to any existing commitments. I also actively read developments on educational technology and pedagogy in the evolving AI scenario. My background: I did my Bachelors in Data science from IIT Madras. I'm currently working on hallucination in Visual Language Models (VLMs) at IIT Hyderabad. Prev. research internship experience: IIT Roorkee, IISER Kolkata.

item.title: The Hours That Didn't Feel Wasted
item.description: I spent the pandemic building things, debugging everything myself and falling in love with programming. Years later, AI has made coding dramatically easier and I'm starting to notice that some of what made it satisfying has quietly disappeared.

item.title: Beyond MCQs: Pedagogical Insights from LogicLooM's Creativity Round
item.description: Introducing subjective questions impacted participant performance, revealing the gap between traditional auto-graded metrics and actual problem-solving skills.
